summary.text: Adam Bauman, a Republican business owner and U.S. Navy Special Warfare Combatant Crewman veteran, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Texas's 16th District to Rep. Veronica Escobar.
He also served on the U.S. Border Patrol's tactical team.
His campaign website emphasized lower property taxes, border security and veterans' issues.

paragraphs.text: Bauman served in the U.S. Navy as a Special Warfare Combatant Crewman (SWCC), according to his campaign website and Ballotpedia.
He later worked with the U.S. Border Patrol as a member of its Border Patrol Tactical Team (BORTAC), which his campaign website describes as a career in the Border Patrol.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.
Bauman advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary to a runoff and won the May 26, 2026 runoff over Manuel Barraza to become the nominee.
He received 29.2% of the vote to Veronica Escobar's 70.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
